title: Head loss through clean flat bar screens

symbols.definition: Velocity through the screen in m/s
Velocity before the screen in m/s

applicability: Head loss created by a clean flat bar screen, calculated from the flow and the effective areas of the screen openings, the latter being the sum of the vertical projections of the openings.
notes: Printed coefficient 0.0729 retained; no correction made.
Uppercase V (velocity through the screen) and lowercase v (velocity before the screen) are distinct in the source and kept distinct.
Usually accepted practice is to provide loss of head of 0.15 m but the maximum loss with clogged hand cleaned screen should not exceed 0.3 m.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every coefficient, power, subscript and cell against 144-dpi region renders, with 400-dpi zoom where needed.
